errors.message: Transient storage as defined by EIP-1153 can break the composability of smart contracts: Since transient storage is cleared only at the end of the transaction and not at the end of the outermost call frame to the contract within a transaction, your contract may unintentionally misbehave when invoked multiple times in a complex transaction. To avoid this, be sure to clear all transient storage at the end of any call to your contract. The use of transient storage for reentrancy guards that are cleared at the end of the call is safe.

@title IGiwaCLPool
 @notice Interface for Giwa Concentrated Liquidity AMM Pools (CLAMM).

@title IGiwaPoolFactory
 @notice Comprehensive Factory Interface for Giwa DEX deploying Concentrated Liquidity and Stableswap Pools.

@title IGiwaStablePool
 @notice Interface for Stableswap pools utilizing amplification coefficient (A) for ultra-low slippage pegged swaps.

@title IGiwaUniversalRouter
 @notice Single entry point for routing swaps across Concentrated Liquidity (CLAMM) and Stableswap pools.

@title IPermit2
 @notice Uniswap Permit2 interface for single-signature batch token approvals.

@title GiwaDCAStreamer
 @notice Automated non-custodial Dollar Cost Averaging (DCA) streaming contract for Giwa Chain.

@title GiwaLimitOrderBook
 @notice Sub-second Flashblocks Limit Order Engine for Hanokswap on Giwa Chain.
@notice Keeper / Sequencer fills limit order when spot price condition is met

@title GiwaUniversalRouter
 @notice Universal Router for Giwa Chain aggregating swaps across Concentrated Liquidity and Stableswap pools with Multi-Hop SOR and Permit2.
